from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single document regarding its citation relationships."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this paper as named in the text")
    references: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Titles of other provided papers that this paper explicitly references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated schema for a single document parsing run."""
    papers: list[Paper]
